svg.text: No BEIR corpus has a document long enough to test the grid
Empirical cumulative distribution of document length in SFR-Embedding-Mistral tokens, as indexed (title + abstract + body). Both
curves are measured here from the study's own artefacts. The two BEIR corpora are shown only as the summary statistics reported
in the plan - their per-document lengths were never computed in this study and are not drawn as distributions.
5 CDS documents run past the axis (max 1.6 M tokens)
in the whole of trec-covid (171,332 docs)
share of documents at or below
Consequence: a 348-token document cannot fill a 2,048-token budget, so on scifact 12 of the 24 grid cells collapse to one chunk per document and the
overlap axis does not exist at all (5,182 of 5,183 documents are a single chunk at size 2,048). That is why the study built its own long-document
judged sets rather than reusing BEIR, and why the fill table measured on scifact must not be used to interpret them. Caveat on the two measured
curves: they are judged / sampled subsets, not whole corpora, and the CDS curve's extreme tail (max 1.6 M tokens) is a handful of book-length
